# hg gitops

**What this page tells you:** every `hg gitops` subcommand, with its arguments, flags and defaults.

Verify or upgrade a destination repo.

## Synopsis

```text
hg gitops doctor <gitops-repo-dir>
hg gitops upgrade <gitops-repo-dir>
```

`--json` prints one JSON document on stdout; narration goes to stderr.

## `hg gitops doctor`

```text
hg gitops doctor <gitops-repo-dir>
```

Verify the scaffold: ownership manifest, generator set, catalogue twins, deployments/ vs plan.yaml.

Edited or deleted managed files are refused via the `scaffold.yaml` ownership manifest.

## `hg gitops upgrade`

```text
hg gitops upgrade <gitops-repo-dir>
```

Adopt a legacy repo in the working tree.

`environment/` synthesized, records moved to the catalogue, fleet compiled, generators swapped, `scaffold.yaml` written. Never commits or pushes — prints the cluster pre-flight the operator runs before push.
